title: Arak-Drizzled Heirloom Tomatoes
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut the tomatoes into thick slices and arrange them on a plate. To make the toum, crush the garlic in a mortar and pestle until it forms a paste-like consistency, then set it in a small bowl with a pinch of salt and add the lemon juice. Add the sunflower oil to the bowl in a slow stream and whisk until emulsified. Season the tomatoes with salt and sumac, then sprinkle them with some arak. Drizzle the toum over the tomatoes and serve.
